title: Sends events from Amazon DynamoDB Streams to Amazon SQS using Amazon EventBridge Pipes
description: Serverless pattern that sends events from DynamoDB Stream to SQS using EventBridge Pipes. Implemented with serverless framework

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This serverless pattern demonstrates how to send events from DynamoDB Stream to SQS using EventBridge Pipes.
Filters are configured on the pipe and matched events are enriched using AWS Lambda. The Lambda function logs information about the event before sending the event to the pipe target (SQS queue).
Filters and enrichment stages are optional and can be configured.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
